svg.title: Work before the first post appears

g.text: Each step is another round trip over the visitor's connection.
The server fetches the profile, then the posts, next to the API while the shell streams.
JavaScript starts once the stylesheet has loaded, then hydrates the shell as it runs.
Side-by-side recording on a desktop browser on Slow 4G, before later performance work.
Screen recording, June 2026, logged out. Slow 4G = 150 ms round trip,
1.6 Mbps down, 750 Kbps up. Times are read from the video and approximate.
